templates.emailSubjectLine: Regarding Your Short Term Medical Plan | UnitedHealthOne - Golden Rule Insurance Co.
templates.body:
Hello {memberName},

Your Short Term Medical plan is valid through {date}.

You may request to cancel the policy; however, you can only apply for a new plan after the current contract period ends, as this policy has a one-year term. Therefore, you would not be able to add your spouse to a new policy before {date}.

We recommend that your dependent apply for a separate policy. Please contact your agent, {agentName}, at {agentNumber} for assistance with the application process.

If you have any further questions, please call us at 1-800-657-8205. We are open Monday through Friday from 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. CT. You may also send us a new secure message, and please allow 3-5 business days for a response.

Thank you, {memberName}, for being a valued UnitedHealthOne customer.

Kindest regards,
Client Services
UnitedHealthOne
